subject: Cloudify partnership onboarding: MAP, listing entitlements, and metering integration
messages:
From: Kate Barnes <kate@cloudify.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Rao <amit.rao@amazon.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partnership onboarding: MAP + listing gating questions

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the chat yesterday — Cloudify is excited to get Redwood listed and enabled for the AWS/GCP marketplace channels. To keep momentum with the buying teams here, can you share a mutual action plan (MAP) skeleton and the specific technical gating items you need from us for listing + co-sell entitlements?

Two items we need clarity on from your side to coordinate with our sales/engineering teams:
- Metering integration: what telemetry/endpoints do you need for usage-based metering?
- Listing gating: do you require a feature-flag or private endpoint for certain regulated customers (we have a per-tenant private endpoint option) and how will that be represented in the listing?

I attached a first-pass MAP from Cloudify (Cloudify_MAP_Draft.docx). Our goal is a live listing and co-sell entitlement enabled within 4–6 weeks, pending any technical blockers. Amit — looping you for any AWS-specific entitlements we should be aware of.

Can we target a short internal Redwood+Cloudify sync early next week to align owners and a timeline?

Thanks,
Kate
Kate Barnes
Head of Strategic Partnerships | Cloudify Solutions
Attachment: Cloudify_MAP_Draft.docx
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Partnership onboarding: MAP + listing gating questions

Team — forwarding Cloudify's ask. TL;DR: partner wants MAP + tech gating answers so they can coordinate with AWS and their engineering team. Proposed internal owners:
- Sales / GTM + MAP: Ben
- Technical metering integration / shim: Karthik
- Listing approvals + contract entitlements: Laura

Please reply with:
1) Owner confirmation and availability for a 30m sync with Cloudify (Kate) and Amit (AWS)
2) A short list of artifacts we need from Cloudify for marketplace listing (evidence, screenshots, private offer pricing, security questionnaire)
3) Any blocker that would prevent a 4–6 week timeline for a first listing + co-sell enablement

Notes: I want to avoid rework — if there are existing checklist items from prior partners, please reference them. Ben — can you also prepare the list of commercial entitlements we can offer in a private offer (discount bands, trial SKUs)?

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference

- Availability: I can join a sync Wed 17 Mar 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 18 Mar 09:00–09:30 PT. Either works; I prefer Wed.
- Artifacts we need from Cloudify:
  * Completed security questionnaire (or current SOC2 report)
  * Architecture diagram for the integration (public vs private endpoints)

On the 4–6 week target: doable if metering shim work is scoped this week and Cloudify can produce the security evidence within the next 10 days.

Ben Carter

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Partnership onboarding: MAP + listing gating questions — metering details

Adding technical specifics for metering:
- Redwood will expose a lightweight POST /metering/events endpoint (auth via service token) that accepts batched JSON payloads. We can support both per-invocation and per-concurrency meters; partner should declare preferred meterId.
- Required fields: timestamp, customer_id (external_id), sku_id, quantity, event_signature (HMAC).
- Expected SLA: shim should buffer locally and retry on 5xx; we recommend 1–2 minute batching windows to optimize tokenization cost.
- Security: TLS 1.2+, mTLS optional for high-security accounts; we will need Cloudify to provide CA or support Let's Encrypt for private endpoint certs.
- Deliverables from our side: stub swagger for the endpoint, sample client, and a reference shim (metering_shim_design_v1.zip). ETA for reference shim: 2 dev-weeks starting Mon 22 Mar.

Open questions for Cloudify:
1) Do you prefer per-invocation (fine-grained) or per-seat/hour (coarser) metering?
2) Any regulatory constraints that require tenant isolation / private endpoints?

I attached the metering design zip with a readme and sample payloads. If we get answers to Q1/Q2 this week, we can hit Ben’s 4–6 week target.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Engineer, Integrations | Redwood Inference
Attachment: metering_shim_design_v1.zip

Subject: Re: Partnership onboarding: MAP + listing gating questions — next steps and DocuSign

Vivek / team — thanks for the quick follow-ups and the artifacts. Answers to your open questions:
- Metering: we prefer per-invocation billing for the initial SKU set. We’ll provide mapping of legacy meters to sku_id by EOD Mon 22 Mar.
- Tenant isolation: we have customers that will need a private endpoint option — please flag which parts of the listing should advertise that as an enterprise capability.
- Security evidence: we can share our current SOC2 report and a filled questionnaire by Tue 23 Mar.

We’ve uploaded an initial MAP and a co-sell offer PDF to our shared drive and sent a DocuSign for a standard co-sell acknowledgement (Cloudify_DocuSign_COSELL_OFFER.pdf). Link: https://www.docusign.com/3q2-cloudify-redwood-cosell

Tentative timeline:
- Mon 22 Mar: Cloudify provides meter mapping + security evidence
- Tue 23 Mar: Redwood provides stub swagger and reference shim artifacts (Karthik)
- Wed 24 Mar: GTM sync to finalize MAP and private offer SKUs (Ben + Laura + Cloudify)

Amit — would love your help confirming any AWS entitlement steps we should surface in the MAP (private offers, co-sell enablement).

Kate
Kate Barnes
Head of Strategic Partnerships | Cloudify Solutions
